decisions.reason: As a low-marginal-cost extension of the firm’s core dental software that fits the push toward larger, more digital and paperless practices, the XL anamnesis package is worth keeping because uncertainty about demand can be resolved while the option remains inexpensive to maintain.

The support service for dental assistants matches the firm’s service-heavy model and can strengthen customer retention, but because it likely requires ongoing staffing and may reveal its value faster than a software module, it has a somewhat higher—though still minority—chance of being withdrawn.
